Reset preview selected ON/STANDARD/WEAK; both X and Y discarded it and restored saved user values. Five OSD positions including new DEFAULTS row, OSD1 exclusion/centering, input blocking and all-button release wait passed. No extra SAVE requested; PC verification of generation and file integrity remains pending.

reports.phase: Global inheritance, user priority, Reset SAVE and power cycle
reports.scope: Japanese list/order and both games video/audio/controls normal. Pac-Man initially retained USER ON/STRONG/STANDARD above global defaults. Reset preview inherited global ON/WEAK/STRONG from blank NES row; one SAVE stayed open and SAVED. Relaunch and power cycle restored GLOBAL/RESET/SAVED with ON/WEAK/STRONG, expected ROM ID, DEFAULTS OK and FRAME ACK. Dr.Mario retained CSV ON/WEAK/STANDARD, RESET/SAVED, expected ROM ID, DEFAULTS OK and FRAME ACK. PC verification of the new Reset generation and unchanged files remains pending.

limitations: NES system/global behavior, priorities, Reset and OSD checks passed; PC audits confirmed the system/global trial records and unchanged defaults/other files. Invalid-file hardware fallback and final cleanup/integrity remain pending. Other systems/volumes/I/O failures are host-tested only.
